column1: # Hand light table for the lighting module (deployed to pst_forever\assets\vfx\vfxlight.tsv).
# Any world draw whose BAM matches the pattern ('?' = any one char) carries this light, centred on the
# drawn frame, standing on its bottom edge, z px up.
# pattern   r     g     b     radius  z   kind   [strength]
# "anim:N" instead of a pattern = a creature light: every creature of animation id N (RESDATA.INI [N])
# carries it at its own position (feet), z px up, whatever frame it draws (no jumping with the sprite).
# Flags after the strength: noshadow (the creature is the light: no contact/key shadow, nothing blocks
# its light), glow=PATTERN (its BAMs keep their full brightness: emissive, bloom).
# Ignus burns permanently: RESDATA.INI [36] (his BAMs are ????IGYB). Steady: no flicker.
